title: The constant 2-covector a♭ ∧ e♭
statement: For P ∈ ℕ and a, e ∈ ℝ^P there is a continuous alternating 2-form β ∈ Covector(ℝ^P, 2) (= ℝ^P [⋀^Fin 2]→L[ℝ] ℝ) with β(v) = ⟨a, v₀⟩⟨e, v₁⟩ − ⟨a, v₁⟩⟨e, v₀⟩ for every v : Fin 2 → ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (a e : Euclid P), ∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) 2, ∀ v : Fin 2 → Euclid P, β v = inner ℝ a (v 0) * inner ℝ e (v 1) - inner ℝ a (v 1) * inner ℝ e (v 0)
